title: Green countdown carries provenance
description: No pill: the estimated countdown number itself renders in the live/ok green, while schedule-only rows stay ink. Colour alone signals provenance, decoded by a one-line key beneath the list. Cleanest per-row, but colour-only — pair with the key (or a redundant glyph) for colour-blind legibility.
baseline_ref: app/components/ArrivalRow.vue: .arrival-row__eta is --color-ink for all rows; estimated rows carry a separate pill

changes.intent: Expose the estimated flag on the row so the eta can be coloured by it, and remove the separate pill/prefix.
changes.detail: Add :class binding arrival.estimated && 'arrival-row--estimated' to the row. Remove the .arrival-row__badge--estimated pill and the .arrival-row__scheduled prefix span.

changes.intent: Colour the estimated countdown with the existing live/ok token so the number itself reads as real-time.
Add a small legend so the colour is decodable; only render it when at least one arrival is estimated.
changes.detail: Below the arrival list, when arrivals.some(a => a.estimated), render a muted key row: a green dot + 'Verde = salida estimada en tiempo real'. Reuse the --color-ok dot styling from .arrival-row__badge-dot.
